status: source-reviewed proposal; execute only after measured Kricketune prep checkpoint
rationale: Owned Kricketune already has PerishSong. Both trainer PULSE mons have no boss flag or Soundproof and cannot switch after their owner has no reserve. FullRestore/Moonlight do not erase PerishSong. Saves one-to-two HeartScale detours.

Zero.entry: Preserve fullHP Kricketune with FocusSash until finalClaw. If hail exists, decline free switch; wait for active ally to faint, then choose Kricketune after endround for fullHP Sash. Never normal switch into Claw attack then hail.
Zero.turn: FullHP Sash survives single-hit Claw move; PerishSong then faint/normal switch. Observe count3 at first endround, then three additional rounds to0 using living reserves/revives. FullRestore does not clear count.
Zero.not_guaranteed: Must first win Spiritomb/Houndoom/Honchkrow/Weavile/Umbreon and preserve normal healthy reserves; Sash must remain unspent.

Mime.entry: Kricketune+Sylveon leads, fully healed. Require measured KricketuneHP>100 andSpeed>87. Mime100 NightShade100 cannotKO fullKrick; first-turn Instruct has no previous Aromatisse move; other Mime moves do not prevent Song. Krick moves before Aroma87.
Mime.turn1: Kricketune PerishSong, SylveonMistyTerrain if available; confirm visible song/counters.
Mime.following: Switch both own singers out before count0 (prefer T2), handle any faint replacements normally. Mime only has one owner Pokemon; cannot switch and falls on fourth endround including casting. Sigmund may switch Aroma normally; inspect visible named arrivals and continue full fight.
Mime.bag_correction: X battler items allowed only slot0 or when0fainted, and skip ownslot2. Ordinary medicine item registration does not invoke this X-item skip. Earlier two-actor XSpecial planning was invalid.

candy: Four owned XL candies reserved for Kricketune to gain HP/speed. Verify actual stats after normal candy; no level95 assumption.
